claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a baseline for exploring more sophisticated regularization and optimization strategies.
Jasper achieved state-of-the-art results on LibriSpeech with a word error rate (WER) of 2.95% on test-clean.
The architecture uses a combination of batch normalization and ReLU, which outperformed other configurations in experiments.
Jasper was evaluated across multiple datasets, including LibriSpeech and Wall Street Journal, demonstrating competitive performance.
